He then said my money is already transferred to blockchain but even after 1 day it didn‚Äôt arrive, they suggested for I contact blockchain since my profit is huge. I told her I‚Äôm completely empty-handed so I can only pay $500, and she agreed. So I paid that as well, however, she kept asking money from me for different fees, which I dined to pay.
